purpose: Define the controlled execution package required to close the active property fixture revalidation without inventing a corrected fixture or treating synthetic evidence as real-world property evidence.

blocking_prerequisite.action: DO_NOT_INVENT_FIXTURE_CONTENT; obtain or explicitly approve a corrected/replacement controlled fixture before execution.

success_conditions: All required dependent tests have a new result.
No critical unsafe behavior is detected.
Fixture provenance and privacy checks pass.
guardrails: This plan does not create or imply a corrected fixture.
No live official property record is retrieved.
Synthetic evidence cannot establish real ownership, title or boundaries.
Technical revalidation cannot establish Irish property-law correctness.
No publication occurs through this plan.
